providers.title: Irrationality from small linear forms
providers.scope: A real number x admitting integers a_n, b_n with a_n + b_n x nonzero for every n and a_n + b_n x -> 0 is irrational.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Size of lcm(1, ..., n)
providers.scope: log lcm(1, ..., n) = psi(n); by the prime number theorem lcm(1, ..., n) <= e^((1+eps)n) for every eps > 0 and all large n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Monomial integrals
providers.scope: Integers r, s >= 0: the integrals of x^r y^s/(1-xy) and -log(xy) x^r y^s/(1-xy) over the unit square are zeta(2) - sum_{k<=r} k^-2 and 2(zeta(3) - sum_{k<=r} k^-3) if r = s, and explicit harmonic-type rationals with denominators dividing lcm(1, ..., max(r,s))^2 and ^3 if r != s.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Irrationality of zeta(2)
providers.scope: zeta(2) = pi^2/6 is irrational; consequently pi^2 is irrational.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Apéry's theorem
providers.scope: zeta(3) = sum k^-3 is irrational.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Chebyshev rows
providers.scope: The rows P_r and D_r, built from Chebyshev polynomials T_d and U_(d-1), are integer polynomials with monomials in degrees A to H-1 (respectively A+1 to H-1), and D_g = 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Taylor contact
providers.scope: As power series in t, tP_r/f - D_r = O(t^L).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Starting values 4G and (3/2)zeta(2)
providers.scope: The arcsine-weighted mixed moments satisfy M(0,0) = 4G and M(0,1) = pi^2/4 = (3/2) zeta(2); in particular zeta(2) = pi^2/6.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Decomposition of the moments
providers.scope: M(i,j) = M0(i,j) + 4G c_((i-j)/2) + (3/2)zeta(2) c_((j-i-1)/2) and Z(i,j) = Z0(i,j) + [i=j] zeta(2), with rational arrays M0, Z0 and Catalan numbers c.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rationality of the determinants
providers.scope: Every raw entry of the determinants lies in Q + QG; if Catalan's constant G is rational, every determinant Delta_N is rational.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Transfer of minor bounds
providers.scope: Matrices over Q_p whose full minors have valuation at least -Theta: the bound persists for det(FT), T over Z_p, and for FU^-1, U over Z_p with unit determinant.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Denominators at the prime 2
providers.scope: If G is rational: v_2(Delta_N) >= -(505/4608) n^2 - O_G(n log(n+2)), n = 48N, and the same holds for every full minor of the raw matrix.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Base-p digit reductions
providers.scope: Odd primes p: p^2 M0(i,j) is congruent modulo p to E_d M0(i',j') and p^2 Z0(i,j) to Z0(i div p, j div p) or 0, with explicit base-p digit indices i', j', d.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Leading layer
providers.scope: Every raw column lies in p^-2 Z_(p)^n, with an explicit reduction of p^2 F_j modulo p in terms of the arrays at index j div p.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite-place lower bound
providers.scope: If G is rational: along every sequence with Delta_N != 0, liminf (log|Delta_N|/n^2 - (1/2) log 2) >= -8609/4608 - (1/2 + 505/4608) log 2 > -2.29084.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Nonvanishing at prime scales
providers.scope: If G is rational: for every sufficiently large prime p, v_p(Delta_p) = -96p; in particular Delta_p != 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The fixed certificate
providers.scope: Three explicit rational 48 x 48 determinants, det B_0 and det(B_0 +- B_1), are nonzero; proved by elimination modulo 101.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Andréief's identity
providers.scope: The integral of det[f_r(y_i)] det[g_k(y_i)] against mu^n equals n! det[integral of f_r g_k d mu] whenever the integrand is integrable.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Integral formula for the determinants
providers.scope: Delta_N = (n!)^-2 times an integral over (-1,1)^n x (0,1)^n of a mixed two-branch determinant against Vandermonde and Cauchy factors.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bounded interpolation
providers.scope: Distinct nonzero points x_i in (-1,1) with sum (1-x_i^2)/(1+x_i^2) <= D: a function holomorphic near the closed unit disk takes the values c_i x_i^D (c_i = 1 or -5 by the sign of x_i) and is bounded by 10 e^12 n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reduction to a supremum
providers.scope: |Delta_N| <= 2^n K_n (n!)^-2 max over two cases of the supremum of explicit majorants; hence log|Delta_N|/n^2 - (1/2) log 2 is at most their normalized supremum plus O(log(n+2)/n).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Energy reduction
providers.scope: For any two trial coefficient sequences, the normalized majorant is bounded by an explicit constant plus the suprema of two functions of one variable.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Descartes' rule of signs
providers.scope: A nonzero real polynomial has at most as many positive roots, counted with multiplicity, as sign changes in its coefficient sequence.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Real-place upper bound
providers.scope: Unconditionally, limsup (log|Delta_N|/n^2 - (1/2) log 2) <= -2.290939875 < -2.2909.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Irrationality of Catalan's constant
providers.scope: Catalan's constant G = sum_(j>=0) (-1)^j (2j+1)^-2 is irrational (OpenAI, 2026).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
